costs.text: Costs per order: brokerage Rs 20, STT 0.15% of premium on sells, NSE transaction charge 0.03553% of premium, SEBI Rs 10 per crore, stamp duty 0.003% on buys, GST 18% on brokerage + transaction + SEBI, plus slippage of half the bid-ask (3% of price where there is no book, at least 0.05). Rates as in force on 2026-11-27; an in-the-money long held to expiry pays STT of 0.15% of intrinsic on exercise. Every leg is charged on opening and again on closing at the same premium: an upper bound, since a leg left to expire worthless pays nothing to close.

method: POP and touch from the risk-neutral density implied by today's smile (IV backed out at each strike, Black-Scholes on the put-call-parity forward, r = 0; CDF = 1 + dC/dK; touch = 2 x P(finish beyond)). EV from the desk distribution: NIFTY's n-session moves since 2007 re-scaled to a 14.2% forecast vol, and raw; the worse of the two, after costs, per lot. Historical breach: closes only, sigma from India VIX on the day.
